annotations.title: Read a tab of the Events page

description: One tab of the dashboard's Events page with the exact numbers behind it. overview: totals against the previous period and every event with users, count, previous count, worked and failed, plus key events. screens: views, users and time per screen. taps: taps per screen and element. broken_taps: dead and rage taps. sessions: length, bounce, entry and exit screens, platforms, versions, recent sessions. devices: app version, OS, model, country, locale and more. Days are in UTC. Tables are capped at 60 rows.
